items.description: Tenant must reimburse Landlord, as Additional Rent, for added insurance premiums resulting from Tenant's failure to comply with the use limitations.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to reimburse Landlord, as Additional Rent, for any additional insurance premium charged by Landlord’s insurance carrier for any insurance policy by reason of Tenant’s failure to comply with the provisions of this Section 6.1.1.

items.description: Tenant must reimburse Landlord for losses caused by unauthorized parties using access devices issued to Tenant or other Tenant Parties.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to reimburse Landlord for any losses, costs or damages caused by unauthorized parties who gain access to the Tenant Space or the Building through access cards, keys or other access devices provided to Tenant (or any other Tenant Party) by Landlord.

items.description: Tenant and other Tenant Parties must fully comply with the Datacenter Rules and Regulations.
items.span_text: Tenant’s Permitted Use shall be subject to, and Tenant, and all other Tenant Parties, shall comply fully with the Datacenter Rules and Regulations.

items.description: Landlord must give Tenant written notice of changes to the Datacenter Rules and Regulations.
items.span_text: Landlord shall notify Tenant in writing when changes are made to Datacenter Rules and Regulations.
items.trigger: when changes are made to Datacenter Rules and Regulations

items.description: Tenant must, at its own cost, ensure Alterations and its use of the Tenant Space comply with Applicable Laws throughout the Term.
items.span_text: Tenant, at Tenant’s sole cost and expense, shall timely take all action required to cause all Alterations and Tenant’s (and all other Tenant Parties’) use of the Tenant Space to comply at all times during the Term of this Lease in all respects with all Applicable Laws

items.description: Landlord must keep the Building and Premises in material compliance with Applicable Laws throughout the Term, apart from Tenant's own compliance obligations.
items.span_text: Landlord covenants to timely take all action required to cause the Building and the Premises to be in material compliance with all Applicable Laws, including the requirements of all applicable easement and encumbrance documents throughout the Term.

items.description: Tenant and Tenant Parties must not handle Hazardous Materials in the Tenant Space, Building or Property.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees that neither Tenant, nor any other Tenant Party, shall Handle any Hazardous Materials in the Tenant Space or any portion of the Building or the Property.

items.description: Landlord must indemnify, defend and hold Tenant harmless from losses and costs caused by Hazardous Materials present at the Premises or Property as of the Effective Date.
items.span_text: Landlord shall indemnify, defend upon demand with counsel reasonably acceptable to Tenant and hold Tenant harmless from and against, any liabilities, losses, claims, demands, interest, penalties, fines, attorneys’ fees, experts’ fees, court costs, remediation costs, and other expenses actually incurred by Tenant as a result of the presence of any Hazardous Materials in, on, about, under or emanating from the Premises or Property as of the Effective Date of this Lease.

items.description: Tenant must immediately act to bring power consumption in each Suite to or below the Electricity Consumption Threshold after an overage.
items.span_text: In the event that an ECT Overage occurs, Tenant agrees to take immediate action to cause power consumption in each Suite to be at or below the Electricity Consumption Threshold for the respective Suite.
items.trigger: In the event that an ECT Overage occurs

items.description: Tenant must not place a load on the Premises or Building exceeding the Maximum Structural Load.
items.span_text: Tenant shall not place a load upon the Premises or the Building exceeding the Maximum Structural Load.

items.description: Landlord must provide its Access Control Systems throughout the Term.
items.span_text: Landlord will provide Landlord’s Access Control Systems during the Term of this Lease.

items.description: Landlord must use commercially reasonable efforts to update the access list within one hour of a written request made during business hours.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees to use commercially reasonable efforts to perform “adds to” and “removals from” such authorized “access list” within one (1) hour after receiving any written notice of such request that is provided between the hours of 8:00 am and 5:00 pm on business days.
items.trigger: written notice of such request that is provided between the hours of 8:00 am and 5:00 pm on business days

items.description: Landlord must retain Common Area surveillance recordings for a rolling period and give Tenant access within a stated period after a written request.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees (a) to retain the recordings of the Common Area’s video surveillance system for at least a rolling period of thirty (30) consecutive days, and (b) to provide Tenant access to such recordings within a reasonable period (being no more than 2 business days) following Landlord’s receipt of written request for access to same.
